title: Reconcile superseded source-bound failure PRs
rawUserRequest: 在发布前整理远端和本地分支；在替代修复合并后，关闭已被替代的失败 PR，但保留其失败审计证据。所有计划工单已经授权持续执行。

declaredIntent.summary: Close the five failed source-bound PRs superseded by successful PR #524, while preserving their provider and archived failure evidence for audit.

outOfScope: Deleting semantic-version tags, provider Releases, or origin/main.
Editing immutable archive evidence from the failed PRs.
Deleting unrelated branches or worktrees; that is reserved for the final pre-publication convergence Work Item.
Publishing a release or modifying runtime, CI, test, or documentation behavior.

sources.reason: Failed source-bound evidence finalization PR superseded by the successful current-main delivery.
Failed installed-runtime format corrective superseded by the successful current-main delivery.
Failed finish-readiness corrective superseded by the successful current-main delivery.
Failed source-bound standard verification PR whose architecture is delivered by #524.
Failed Ruff-parity replacement whose Bandit root cause is resolved by #524.
Merged successor with successful template-smoke, installation-smoke, release-evidence, ci-evidence, compatibility, and CodeQL evidence.
Authoritative rule that obsolete unmerged PRs must not be revived and cleanup follows verified replacement evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: Closing an exact provider PR is externally visible and may delete its remote head branch. Each target has failed CI evidence and a concrete merged successor, but the audit relation and postconditions must be recorded before closure.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the plan, branch cleanup before release, and continued lifecycle execution without repeated confirmation.

preReviewWarnings: Close only exact PR numbers after recording their failed state and #524 successor relation; do not delete provider evidence or tags.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Bind exact provider closure targets and postconditions before external state changes.

acceptance: The Summary records PR #519, #520, #521, #522, and #523 with exact head SHA, failed Hosted state, and the specific successor relationship to merged PR #524.

Each of the five exact PRs is closed as superseded only after verifying #524 is merged and its source-bound aggregate evidence reports template-smoke, installation-smoke, and release-evidence as success for its Head SHA.
No failed archive record, semantic tag, provider Release, runtime source, CI, test, or product documentation is modified.
Provider postconditions show the five PRs closed; remote head branches are reported truthfully for later final convergence rather than inferred.
Focused governance and aggregate PR checks pass under the temporary local efficiency authorization; Hosted CI for this evidence-only closure Work Item passes before merge.
guidelines: Use exact PR numbers, head SHAs, and successor links; never close a PR merely because its name sounds obsolete.
Preserve failed provider and archive evidence; close PRs rather than rewriting history.
Keep the Work Item limited to reconciliation evidence and provider closure; reserve broad branch/worktree deletion for final convergence.
Use focused local verification under the temporary authorization; do not weaken Hosted checks.

intent.problem: Five open source-bound PRs (#519 through #523) each have failed Hosted CI and have been superseded by merged PR #524. Leaving them open contradicts the required pre-release branch convergence and risks accidentally reviving an invalid implementation path.
constraints: Close only the five enumerated PRs after recording their exact head SHA and failed result.
Preserve provider failure logs and immutable Work Item archives; do not edit prior records.
Do not delete tags, releases, origin/main, unrelated branches, or worktrees.
Run focused local governance checks; full local quality is optional under the recorded temporary efficiency exception, while Hosted CI remains mandatory.
intent.rationale: A single bounded reconciliation record makes the successor relation reviewable, closes only verified obsolete PRs, and leaves destructive final branch/worktree convergence to its own audited Work Item.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized efficiency exception for evidence-only reconciliation; Hosted CI remains mandatory.

approvalEvidence.reason: The user authorized ongoing plan execution and required obsolete remote branches to be cleaned before release.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized cleanup before release and continuous execution of plan Work Items.

rollbackNote: Do not reopen a closed failed PR as rollback. Its provider and archive evidence remain available; a later corrective Work Item must create a new branch if #524 is disproven.
